follicular.partner: Energy levels are rising! Great time to support outdoor activities or try new recipes together.
follicular.parent: Your family member is in the follicular phase. Encouraging balanced nutrition supports steady energy.
follicular.sibling: High energy phase! Good time for fun family activities.
follicular.teacher: Student is likely experiencing peak cognitive energy and focus during this phase.

ovulatory.partner: Peak confidence and communication phase. Be encouraging and share active quality time.
ovulatory.parent: Ovulatory phase typically brings high social energy and positive mood.
ovulatory.sibling: Great time to catch up and talk.
ovulatory.teacher: Phase marked by strong social engagement and presentation confidence.

luteal.partner: Progesterone is rising. Extra warmth, patience, and a relaxing environment are deeply appreciated.
luteal.parent: Progesterone phase. Offering warm meals and reducing home stress helps comfort them.
luteal.sibling: Be supportive and offer help with household chores.
luteal.teacher: Focus and energy may shift slightly. Supportive, steady study environments work best.

menstrual.partner: Rest and recovery phase. Offering a warm drink, heating pad, or lighter schedule goes a long way.
menstrual.parent: Menstrual phase. Ensure comfortable space, iron-rich foods (spinach, lentils, jaggery), and plenty of fluids.
menstrual.sibling: Be gentle and offer to help with daily tasks.
menstrual.teacher: Rest and physical comfort are key. Hydration and flexible posture during class are beneficial.
